doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

title: National Park and Eddie Vinson at the Langford-Wills fight, 1918
summary: National Park was at Third and Claiborne, with baseball games and prize fights. Eddie Vinson came in 1918 for the Sam Langford and Harry Wills fight and played saxophone with Tom's band, then left and came back when his sister was sick.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: You mentioned National Park. That was over on this side. Where was that about, National Park?

Third and Claiborne. Claiborne and what? Right where that school is. Third and Willow, third and Claiborne. They had baseball games there? Baseball games. They had pride fighting. That's where Eddie come here in 18 when Sam Langford and Harry Wills. You was there.

Well, I played. Eddie was playing. Eddie played the trampoline. We had our band played in there. Eddie played the saxophone. That's right. He played that at night. Sam Langford. Then he left. Then he left on out of here. Yes, that's what it is. I played that at night.

He did saxophone. Then he come back. He come back and trying to get Joe all over the first time. and he couldn't get him. Joe all over the world and go. Then he left and go back and come back when his sister was sick there. What a name that guru one. Eddie's sister. Uh, shaman. No. Uh, Tatsu. Tatsu. Tatsu. Tatsu. Tatsu. Well. That's when he got Joe all over.
